messages:
zoe: Ben submitted resignation, last day 2027-02-12. Need owners for access, final pay, device return, and COBRA timing.

ben: Confirming last day 2027-02-12. Laptop SN: RW-GL-1024. I have one personal SSH key and one PAT in my account. Happy to hand over admin roles.

zoe: Draft actions: create offboard ticket (People Ops), schedule exit interview, disable SSO on last day (IT), revoke keys/PATs, rotate vault secrets, confirm device drop-off or label, send COBRA packet (payroll).

it-ops-bot: Created IT-12843 "Ben offboard - access + device". Assigned to Ben. ETA 1 business day.

payroll: COBRA/benefits end 2027-02-28 (EOM). We'll send opt-in instructions 2027-02-13. Final payout processed on next payroll run after termination.

ben: I'll drop laptop at reception on 2/12 AM. I'll add backups and transfer Sentry admin rights today.

zoe: Please attach admin transfers and a photo of the serial to the ticket. If any sole-admin SaaS remains, add a new admin now.

it-ops-bot: IT-12843 updated with repo admin list and device serial photo placeholder.
